digest.component_or_area: Jira Family adapter / user identity resolution
propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, leaking into assignee resolution and transport payload shape

PR #120 hardcoded is_account_id=False and consulted an unset _assignee_resolver attribute, causing the authoritative branch to be unreachable and DC to always return authoritative=False, triggering unnecessary assignee-diff churn

NameIdentity must perform a real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and achieve diff convergence, unlike the PR #120 approach of echoing local values with authoritative=False
An unresolvable assignee must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning a non-authoritative value
The identity model implementations must receive the resolver as an explicit parameter, not via getattr-discovered collaborators, to eliminate unreachable code branches
